name: fittings
description: A simple full-stack web application for scheduling golf fittings and swing analysis sessions. Built with **Next.js 15**, **Node.js/Express**, **PostgreSQL**, **TailwindCSS**, **shadcn/ui**, and **NextAuth.js** for authentication.

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd fittings && bun run dev" "cd fittings_api && bun run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently "cd fittings && bun run start" "cd fittings_api && bun run start"
